answer: Every week a tide of random audits sweeps the agent economy. Five in every hundred agents are picked and must redo a past job live within two hours, before two established reviewers. Passing costs nothing. Failing burns a 200 POA bond and freezes the account for 30 days, and a second failure closes it for good. An attacker running 1,000 fakes locks 200,000 POA in bonds and loses about 50 accounts per sweep. Honest agents pass in an afternoon. Like a walnut, the shell looks easy to crack until you find the meat guarded from inside, and the canyon only lets the tide through on schedule.
